name: All-local VR.net parameters to real self-report regression
input_root: data/raw/vrnet; deduplicated expanded CSV and existing ZIP CSV members
window_origin: first finite timestamp in each session
rotation_rate_flag_policy: quality flag only; no automatic clipping
camera_selection: fixed first valid preferred Main/Center camera per session
acceleration: 3D interval velocity-vector difference divided by velocity-midpoint time difference
matrix_convention: audited serialized row-vector layout; inverse view translation row 3; fixed camera-space Z reflection removed
fov: full asymmetric perspective frustum opening; unsupported projection missing
object_count: valid serialized 4x4 m_matrix entries per sampled row; not total authored scene objects
label_pairing: nearest finite real MS_rating to 5-second window midpoint within same session; earlier report wins a tie
future_labels: allowed by requested nearest rule; signed distance and future flag recorded

optional_csv_features.motion_flow: absent from all local headers; omitted
optional_csv_features.depth: absent from all local headers; omitted

target: unchanged finite MS_rating; no generated labels or score imputation
validation: Leave-One-Game-Out; whole sessions and rating events stay in the same game fold
preprocessing: training-fold median imputation and VarianceThreshold(1e-10); no test-game normalization
fit_weights: equal sessions; within session equal rating events; within event equal windows
auc: supplementary ROC-AUC for actual MS_rating>2, ranking by continuous regression prediction; fixed threshold
predeclared_sensitivity: same fixed model retrained with nearest-rating absolute distance <=30 seconds; report separately, do not select winning result
uncertainty: 1000 bootstrap draws by session of fixed OOF predictions; conditional on observed games, not retraining or new-game CI
scope_limits: only already-local modern sources, not complete remote VR.net
view-derived camera motion mixes user and navigation
nearest rule can pair future or distant ratings
runtime graphics are not verified authored design settings
original_protocol_gate: not evaluated; real-score regression and derived binary AUC do not replace frozen three-class macro AUC
